'''Sebulba's Podracer''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] famously piloted by the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] racing champion [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

==Characteristics==
Sebulba's Podracer featured two Collar Pondrat [[Plug-F Mammoth Split-X engine/Legends|Plug-F Mammoth]] [[Plug-F Mammoth Split-X engine/Legends|Split-X engines]]. The frontal split-X radiators utilized a ram-air intake system to ensure effective operation of the racer's huge turbines. Although illegal, the engines were fueled by [[tradium]] power fluid pressurized with [[quold runium]], activated with ionized [[Injectrine/Legends|injectrine]], to give the pod an extra speed boost. Because of these attributes, the pod had a loud, unique engine rumble. The estimated maximum speed was 829 km/h and had a maximum altitude of 85 meters.

==History==
[[File:Podrace.png|thumb|left|250px|Sebulba's Podracer in the Boonta Eve Classic]]
Sebulba piloted the huge Podracer on many tracks throughout the galaxy, from the methane lakes of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] to the sandy dunes of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], cheating his way to be the best of the best. Sebulba always brought his famous orange and black Pod to the sands of Tatooine to attend the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]]. With his Podracer, he was always a favorite to win in the Boonta due to his brutal and competitive edge. Sebulba's Podracer was an imposing giant, an orange-hued bully of a craft whose pounding, thundering engine roar seemed powerful enough to knock down opponents. With a top speed of 829 km/h, the racer was very fast, behind the [[Titan 2150 rocket engine/Legends|''Scatalpen'']], the [[BT310 Quadra/Legends|BT310]], and Skywalker's Podracer.

Sebulba modified his Podracer heavily. The controls in his cockpit were designed to fit especially for the [[Dug/Legends|Dug's]] anatomy; Sebulba steers with his hands and operates the finer manipulations of his pod with his dexterous feet, so if any daring racers were to try and sabotage the pod, they could not possibly know what they were working with. So finely tuned with the machinations of his pod, Sebulba knew how to break off parts of its cockpit without damaging it and use them to his advantage. During the Boonta, he broke off a piece of iron from his cockpit and threw it behind him, where it landed in one of [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo's]] [[Plug-2 Behemoth|engine]] fans, resulting in the destruction of Guo's huge engines and sending the [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] into the desert sands within an inch of his life.

In addition to the physical modifications to his cockpit, the crafty Dug installed illegal weaponry in his podracer. In the past, Sebulba installed a nail shooter in the Podracer to shoot nails into opponents' engines, then later replaced it with a buzz saw that would sever an unfortunate Podracer's steelton cables. Finally, Sebulba's weapon of choice was a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] hidden inside a compartment on the side of the engine, which would open up and release a high-powered [[Fire/Legends|fire]], ready to roast any competitor who came too near.  With these myriad modifications, any race official who'd thoroughly peruse the pod would deem it illegal. However, when officials do demand inspections, his podracer always looks clean. To not be disqualified for his [[Death/Legends|murderous]] cheating, the wily dug always removed his illegal weaponry from his pod before an inspection. However, when Sebulba did deploy his armaments on the tracks, not a word was spoken on the matter by his fans or even racing officials. He was simply too beloved to be kicked out of the podracing circuit, having gained a significant fanbase from the crashes and murders in his podracing career.

The Podracer's deadly attributes and illegal fuel system were packed in a gigantic package; the vehicle was one of the largest Podracers ever to be manufactured. If the massive, furious-looking Podracer's mere presence was not enough to awe and intimidate the most fearless of racers, its thundering roars threatening to knock bystanders off their feet certainly did. For its size, it was surprisingly maneuverable, and paired with its exceptional durability, it was a menace on the course. With a simple tug of its reins, Split-X-configured engines effortlessly knocked Podracers off the track and into incoming obstacles without taking so much as a scratch. Sebulba favored this tactic and frequently used it to destroy his opposition. One unfortunate victim and was [[Mawhonic/Legends|Mawhonic]] and his [[GPE-3130 Podracer/Legends|podracer]], which was destroyed when Sebulba rammed the [[Gran/Legends|Gran's]] pod into a wall in [[Mushroom Mesa/Legends|Mushroom Mesa]].

[[File:SebulbaPodracer-SWE.png|thumb|250px|Profile view of Sebulba's Podracer]]
Unfortunately, the Podracer met its end on the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] of 32 BBY; the high-stakes race saw Sebulba engage in a perilous face-off with Anakin Skywalker, who flew a custom [[Radon-Ulzer/Legends|Radon-Ulzer]] racer. Though Sebulba sabotaged the slave boy's pod, Skywalker managed to catch up to his rival, side by side. Near the final stretch of the final lap on [[Hutt Flats/Legends|Hutt Flats]], Sebulba attempted to take advantage of his pod's size and rammed the smaller pod continuously, but he inadvertently managed to lock a hook from his cockpit into one of the latches on Skywalker's cockpit that a steelton cable was attached to, intertwining both pods. The panicked Dug tried his hardest to pull his Podracer away from Anakin's smaller engines, with no avail. Skywalker managed to break free by boosting his engines; Sebulba pulled one last tug of his reins. To Sebulba's surprise and horror, the resulting forces ultimately detached the Pod's steelton cables from the cockpit and sent both Split-X engines flying. The left engine flew into a rock, spun out of control, and then burst into three flaming pieces. His right engine flew opposite, hit the ground, and exploded. His Split-X cockpit bounced up, then nose-dived into the desert, spinning and sliding around until it came to a stop, all with Sebulba still in the cockpit. Cursing and slamming his fist on the side of his cockpit, he survived the crash without even a scratch, only seconds away from crossing the finish line.

Sebulba later replaced his ruined Podracer with the pod that won the Boonta: the racer belonging to Anakin Skywalker.
